arguments.value: 70-year-old Sri Lankan man with 4 years of progressive exertional dyspnea, bilateral renal cortical lesions, elevated ESR, hypocomplementemia, and recent dysesthesia/mononeuritis multiplex was diagnosed with multi-organ IgG4-related disease involving the lungs, kidneys (IgG4 tubulointerstitial nephritis), and peripheral nerves after negative tuberculosis workup and confirmatory renal biopsy with IgG4 staining; he improved rapidly on oral prednisolone.
